app.name: PrintOS
app.tagline: Manage your 3D printing business, from files to profit.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.empty: No spools yet. Add your first spool.

hints.materialType: For example PLA, PETG or TPU.
hints.colorHex: Optional, like #1A2B3C. Shows a colour dot in the list.

errors.amount: Enter a whole number of grams, at least 1.
errors.reason: Enter a reason so the change can be traced.
errors.save: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

business.title: Business & Operations
business.printersSubtitle: Your machines and their running costs
business.calculatorSubtitle: Cost, price and profit per print

auth.modeLabel: Sign in or create an account
auth.passwordRules: At least {min} characters with an upper case letter, a lower case letter and a number.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match. Check them and try again.
errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

settings.title: Settings
settings.costsIntro: These rates feed the cost calculator.

hints.electricityPricePerKwh: What you pay your supplier per kWh.
hints.labourRatePerHour: What your own time is worth per hour.
hints.machineRatePerHour: Wear and depreciation per printing hour.
hints.wastePercent: Extra filament for purge, supports and failed prints.

errors.number: {field} must be a number, for example 0,30.
errors.save: Could not save your settings. Try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

printers.title: Printers
printers.empty: No printers yet. Add your first one.

hints.name: A name you recognise, for example "A1 desk".
hints.power: Average draw while printing, not the maximum.
hints.lifetime: Printing hours until you expect to replace it.

errors.number: {field} must be a whole number or decimal, for example 256.
errors.save: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.

alerts.title: Stock alerts
alerts.none: All materials are above their thresholds.
alerts.materialsSubtitle: Low-stock and reorder levels per material
alerts.intro: Set the grams at which a material counts as low or should be reordered. Leave a field empty to switch that alert off.
alerts.noMaterials: Add a spool first. Its material will appear here.
alerts.lowStockHint: Below this, the material shows as low stock.
alerts.reorderHint: Below this, the material shows as reorder soon. Keep it at or above the low-stock level.

errors.number: Enter a whole number of grams, or leave empty.
errors.order: The reorder level must be at or above the low-stock level.
errors.save: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.

calculator.title: Cost Calculator
calculator.savedEmpty: No saved calculations yet. Save one from the calculator.
calculator.needSetup: Add at least one printer and one spool to start calculating.
calculator.fillIn: Enter the grams and print time to see your price.
calculator.immutable: A saved calculation never changes, even when your rates or prices change later.

hints.margin: Price = cost / (1 - margin - fees). Fees such as platform commission are taken from the selling price.
hints.snapshotName: Optional. Leave empty to use the suggested name.

errors.number: {field} must be a number, for example 12,5.
errors.marginPlusFee: Margin plus fees must stay below 100%.
